def evolved_p88(x, N, rank, world_size, num_devices,
                 cores_per_device, xm, torch, num_nodes=1):
    # Formula: x[i, j] = i XOR j (bitwise XOR of row index i and column index j)
    # Position-based -> compute locally, no collective needed.
    # Since bitwise ops may not be exposed, build XOR via bit-decomposition using
    # only +, -, *, //, % on integer-valued tensors.
    idx = torch.arange(N, device=x.device)
    ii = idx.view(N, 1)
    jj = idx.view(1, N)

    max_val = max(N - 1, 0)
    nbits = max_val.bit_length() if max_val > 0 else 1

    result = ii * 0 + jj * 0  # zeros tensor shaped (N, N) matching ii/jj dtype via broadcast add
    for k in range(nbits):
        p = 2 ** k
        bit_i = (ii // p) % 2
        bit_j = (jj // p) % 2
        xor_bit = bit_i + bit_j - 2 * bit_i * bit_j
        result = result + xor_bit * p

    return result.contiguous().to(x.dtype)
